finding: Word operators also match inside the marker token itself, so a full-line compare of a marker name that holds such a word fails.
why: D-14 requires a line that compares the full marker to pass, but the word boundary sits between a hyphen or colon and a letter, so a marker with `in` or `find` as a name part trips the word alternative on its own name.
fix: Run the word alternative only outside marker tokens, and add a full-line-passes test with a marker name that holds such a word.
evidence: Pattern line 51: r"|\b(?:select-string|in|findstr|find|grep|strstr|sed|awk|sls)\b". The reviewer probe flagged two lines that held only a full-line assignment of such a marker.

finding: URL stripper still swallows a v1 name placed inside a URL by interpolation.
why: The URL pattern lets braces and the dollar sign stay inside the match, so an interpolated name in an f-string URL or after a dollar sign in a shell URL is stripped before the name rule runs, and the check passes.
fix: Also stop the URL match at a brace and a dollar sign.
evidence: URL = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\"'`,;()<>]+"). The reviewer probe answered False for the f-string, dollar and dollar-brace forms.

finding: The marker rule skips every .json file, but hooks/hooks.json holds executable hook command strings.
why: A hook command with grep and a marker in hooks.json passes the check, because .json is classed as prose. D-15 leaves the one file that carries hook commands outside the code class.
fix: Apply the code rule and the marker rule to hooks/hooks.json, or record it as a named gap in D-15.
evidence: `if path.suffix.lower() in PROSE_SUFFIXES: continue`. afkv2/hooks/hooks.json lines 12-14 carry command and args values.

finding: No negative case for a bracket that holds a dict literal and a marker; the new slice rule flags it.
why: The slice alternative treats any colon outside a quoted string inside brackets as a slice, so a list of dicts that holds a marker fails the tree check, and no test pins or rejects that.
fix: Narrow the slice pattern and add a pass case for a list of dicts.
evidence: The reviewer probe flagged a list holding one dict with a marker value, and a list holding a marker string and a dict. The only list pass case is at line 401.

finding: D-14's chosen behaviour (ordinary text with a marker and a listed word fails) has no test; the two old pass cases were deleted, not flipped.
why: A narrowing of the word rule would pass unnoticed.
fix: Add fail cases for the html text line and the yaml text line.
evidence: The diff removes two pass rows, sample.html and sample.yaml. A for-in loop over a marker list is also flagged and no test shows that is intended.

finding: test_every_method_operator_fails cannot prove `find` is in the method list.
why: `x.find(...)` also matches the word alternative, so removing `find` from the method list leaves the case green.
fix: Drop `find` from the method list and from this parametrize list; the word cases cover it.
evidence: The reviewer probe: of the 31 listed operators, the word alternative alone also matches only `find`.

finding: The suffix-set test echoes the production constants; only .png has a behaviour test.
why: 9 of the 10 binary suffixes are never run through the skip path in a behaviour test.
fix: Parametrize test_binary_file_is_skipped over every suffix from a hard-coded list.
evidence: test_binary_file_is_skipped (line 264) uses sample.png and sample.PNG only.
